ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Watermedia for Non-Majors. This course is designed to allow students from other areas of study to explore watermedia as an accompaniment to drawing. Students will explore basic drawing concepts, color theory, and watercolor techniques, such as washes and wet on wet painting. This class focuses on the production of art in a studio environment as well as discussion of the history and theory behind watermedia use. Students with little background knowledge of drawing and watermedia are encouraged to participate as well as those who may have more experience.
